assertions.name: operator-valued mass-tower verified through A = 3
assertions.source: Aggregates 3 per-atom forward-validation witnesses (deuteron H_6, tritium H_9, ³He H_9).

description: Consolidation chain witness for prop:mass-tower-operator-valued. Aggregates per-atom forward-validation witnesses across the QOU spectrum A = 2..3 (D, T, ³He). The operator-valued identity χ^λ(β_K) = Σ Tr(A^λ_{μ_1,...,μ_A}(I) · ⊗ ρ_{μ_i}(β_i)) is forward-validated at the 2-factor level (deuteron, 10⁻¹⁵ rel residual on all 11 λ ⊢ 6 partitions) and at the 3-factor level (tritium + ³He, machine-eps via the overdetermined cross-path). A = 4 (⁴He, H_{12}) is the open frontier — requires H_{12} A-operator extraction which is not yet in the repo.

open_frontier.estimated_compute_time: p(12) = 77 partitions × dim_λ up to 462; full extract at MPFR 50 dps is ~30-60 min via numpy-Hoefsmit (per docs/audits/2026-05-19-cocasimir-compute-bottleneck.md).
open_frontier.next_step: Extend sublemma_2_1_A_operator_extract.py to H_{12} with the 3 inter-nucleon interfaces of ⁴He (pp, pn, nn).
